decisions: Trapping rain water: two-pointer. Track left_max/right_max. Add diff when height < max.
Sliding window max: monotonic deque of indices. Pop right while smaller. Pop left if out of window.
LIP matrix: DFS+memo on each cell. 4 directions if strictly increasing.
N-Queens: sets for cols, diag1(r-c), diag2(r+c). Backtrack row by row.
Alien dict: build graph from adjacent word pairs. Topo sort.
Distinct subseq: dp[i][j] += dp[i-1][j-1] if chars match.
Min window: sliding window + counter. Track formed vs required.
Edit dist: dp[i][j] = 1 + min(insert, delete, replace).
Gas station: if total_gas >= total_cost, answer exists. Reset start when tank < 0.
Histogram: monotonic stack. Area = height * (i - stack[-1] - 1) on pop.
Word ladder: BFS. Try all 26 char changes per position.
